Owned regression for a public static method with a single known class bound, the same direct method-formal seed and result, fixed nominal/wide scalar contexts and closed checked exceptions. The bound is a non-generic class with a closed generic parent. Source/SDK definitions compile with original identities, signatures, roles and Exceptions. Four frozen caller routes cover virtual delegation, callbacks, blocked/null inputs, partial mutation, replacement results, exact failures and late casts. Each profile runs 96 fresh JVM cases twice, nine wrong programs and six same-Code Signature controls. All fixture code is independently authored.
